decision: CSA008358/CSS0045924 is a unique exact local amplicon-compatible candidate for the author-classified CnFLS2 qRT-PCR target among the tested tea FLS paralogs and published CnFLS1 cDNA
new_chun_inference: the early-stage pink-directed C. sinensis FLS locus CSA008358 is CnFLS2-like at the qRT-PCR amplicon, whereas the later white-directed CSA006950 is a distinct FLS paralog; some apparent developmental FLS sign switching can therefore reflect paralog substitution rather than reversal of one gene
claim_ceiling: local exact primer/amplicon compatibility is strong paralog-hypothesis evidence but is not formal full-length orthology; full F01.PB8395 sequence plus gene-tree/synteny evidence is required before naming CSA008358/CSS0045924 the strict CnFLS2 ortholog
